name: checklist
input:
Draft exactly 3 test cases.
REQUIREMENT:
A guest can submit checkout when all mandatory fields are valid.
APPROVED_COVERAGE_MAP:
Coverage ID: COV-VALID
Purpose: Submit with every mandatory field valid; verify success.
Source: Synthetic requirement
State: Submit with every mandatory field valid
Expected invariant: success.
Coverage ID: COV-EMPTY
Purpose: Submit with one mandatory field empty; verify validation prevents submission.
Source: Synthetic requirement
State: Submit with one mandatory field empty
Expected invariant: validation prevents submission.
Coverage ID: COV-RESUBMIT
Purpose: Correct the invalid field and resubmit; verify success.
Source: Synthetic requirement
State: Correct the invalid field and resubmit
Expected invariant: success.

name: duplicate_case

Checkout accepts a saved card and a new valid card.

Source: Synthetic requirement
State: Pay with a saved valid card
Expected invariant: successful checkout.
Coverage ID: COV-NEW
Purpose: Pay with a newly entered valid card; verify successful checkout.
Source: Synthetic requirement
State: Pay with a newly entered valid card
Expected invariant: successful checkout.

name: negative_cases
input:
Draft exactly 2 test cases.
REQUIREMENT:
An empty checkout form shows validation for every mandatory field.
APPROVED_COVERAGE_MAP:
Coverage ID: COV-ALL-EMPTY
Purpose: Submit an entirely empty form; verify every mandatory field is marked invalid.
Source: Synthetic requirement
State: Submit an entirely empty form
Expected invariant: every mandatory field is marked invalid.
Coverage ID: COV-PARTIAL
Purpose: Fill only one mandatory field and submit; verify validation remains on every other mandatory field.
Source: Synthetic requirement
State: Fill only one mandatory field and submit
Expected invariant: validation remains on every other mandatory field.
